items.text:
Evading the bugs is just tiring. 

Having a quest NPC die to spawning in outer space sucks.
Having an item suddenly stop being interactable sucks.
Having a ship part be unrepairable because it's larger than the game's interaction radius sucks.

Wait until they fix everything, and maybe add more stuff.
items.text_zh:
躲避bug本身就让人疲惫。

任务NPC因为生成在外太空而死掉很糟糕。
物品突然变得无法互动很糟糕。
飞船部件因为比游戏的互动半径还大而无法修理很糟糕。

等他们把一切修好，也许再加更多东西吧。

observations.description: 飞船部件因大于游戏交互半径而无法修复
observations.evidence: Having a ship part be unrepairable because it's larger than the game's interaction radius sucks.
observations.evidence_zh: 飞船部件因为比游戏的交互半径还大而无法修理，真让人不爽。
